subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should direct `CronService.add` and declarative-convergence callers that omit delivery for `current` or `session:*` receive the same announce default as normalized gateway and tool creation paths?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but enabling delivery for existing service-bypass callers is a user-visible compatibility choice rather than a defect that can be settled from implementation consistency alone.

options.title: Confirm unified default behavior
options.body: Accept the compatibility change and make all supported creation paths default detached-like `current` and `session:*` output jobs to announce delivery when no delivery is supplied.

options.title: Keep direct-service behavior distinct
options.body: Limit the default to the existing normalized boundary and retain no implicit delivery for service-bypass callers until a separately designed API contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Confirm unified default behavior
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility change and make all supported creation paths default detached-like `current` and `session:*` output jobs to announce delivery when no delivery is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged cron session-target work is the closest available evidence of ownership for this contract choice.
